# ==============================================================================
# Great Expectations Data Quality Suite for Gold Delta Table
# ==============================================================================
import great_expectations as gx
from great_expectations.core.expectation_suite import ExpectationSuite
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# 1. Load Gold Delta Table
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "sadatapulse360lak"
GOLD_PATH = f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_invoices"

df_gold = spark.read.format("delta").load(GOLD_PATH)
row_count = df_gold.count()
print(f"Loaded Gold Delta Table with {row_count} rows for validation.")

# 2. Initialize In-Memory Great Expectations Context
context = gx.get_context(mode="ephemeral")

# 3. Connect PySpark DataFrame as a GX Data Source
data_source = context.data_sources.add_spark(name="synapse_gold_source")
data_asset = data_source.add_dataframe_asset(name="fact_invoices_asset")
batch_definition = data_asset.add_batch_definition_whole_dataframe("gold_batch")
batch = batch_definition.get_batch(batch_parameters={"dataframe": df_gold})

# 4. Define Expectation Suite (Business Quality Rules)
suite = context.suites.add(ExpectationSuite(name="gold_fact_invoices_suite"))

# Rule 1: Row count must not be empty
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectTableRowCountToBeBetween(min_value=1)
)

# Rule 2: Primary Key (invoice_id) must NEVER be null
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToNotBeNull(column="invoice_id")
)

# Rule 3: Primary Key (invoice_id) must be UNIQUE (Zero duplicates)
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToBeUnique(column="invoice_id")
)

# Rule 4: invoice_amount must be positive (No negative billing)
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToBeBetween(column="invoice_amount", min_value=0.0)
)

# Rule 5: payment_status must belong strictly to valid enum
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToBeInSet(
        column="payment_status",
        value_set=["PAID", "PENDING", "OVERDUE", "REFUNDED"]
    )
)

# Rule 6: Currency must be standard 3-letter ISO code
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToBeInSet(
        column="currency",
        value_set=["USD", "EUR", "GBP", "INR", "CAD"]
    )
)

# Rule 7: due_date must be greater than or equal to invoice_date
suite.add_expectation(
    gx.expectations.ExpectColumnPairValuesAToBeGreaterThanB(
        column_A="due_date",
        column_B="invoice_date",
        or_equal=True
    )
)

# 5. Execute Validation
validation_definition = context.validation_definitions.add(
    gx.ValidationDefinition(
        name="gold_validation_def",
        data=batch_definition,
        suite=suite
    )
)

validation_results = validation_definition.run(batch_parameters={"dataframe": df_gold})

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Evaluation & Circuit Breaker Logic
# ==============================================================================
success = validation_results.success
statistics = validation_results.statistics

print("=" * 60)
print(f" GREAT EXPECTATIONS VALIDATION RESULT: {'PASSED' if success else 'FAILED'}")
print(f" Evaluated Expectations: {statistics.get('evaluated_expectations', 0)}")
print(f" Successful Expectations: {statistics.get('successful_expectations', 0)}")
print(f" Unsuccessful Expectations: {statistics.get('unsuccessful_expectations', 0)}")
print(f" Success Percent: {statistics.get('success_percent', 0):.2f}%")
print("=" * 60)

# If any critical check failed, print details and fail the pipeline
if not success:
    print("\n--- Failed Expectations Details ---")
    for res in validation_results.results:
        if not res.success:
            rule_name = res.expectation_config.type
            kwargs = res.expectation_config.kwargs
            print(f"Failed: {rule_name} on {kwargs}")
    
    # Circuit Breaker: Fail this Synapse Activity so ADF halts execution!
    raise ValueError("Data Quality threshold breached! Gold table has invalid records. Halting pipeline.")
else:
    print("All Great Expectations validations passed! Ready for Power BI consumption.")
